text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Learning that Air Groove is overseeing a
dance lesson for a group of
other students
after school, I decide to drop by and
watch.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Stay in formation! First the box step,
then
the turn! Maintain eye
contact!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: O-okay!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're finished if you fall behind tempo!
Next is a heel step. Get
ready to come
forward!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: O-okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While her tone is stern,
the instruction is
precise. This is an Air
Groove dance lesson
through and through.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Okay,
let's switch to pair training. Get with
a partner and begin the
routine!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hm? Were you always there?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The winning concert is an integral part of
any Umamusume's duties.
Naturally, dance
practice is going to be tough.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: It's so awesome to get lessons from the Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Can't be sloppy in front of her! Let's do
this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The excited dancer stumbles out of line.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hey, keep your eyes on—you'll fall!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Eek!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove rushes over to cushion the
girl's
fall.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Ow ow ow...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Waaaahhh! Air Groove! Are—are you
okay?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine...
This is nothing to be alarmed by.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After some initial resistance,
I convince Air
Groove to come with me
to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The physician declares it a minor sprain.
There is a little swelling, but
fortunately
there's no damage to the ligaments or
bone.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Then there's nothing stopping me from
getting back to work. If you'll
excuse me, I
have a lesson to teach.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What do you want? Those girls are
counting on me for instruction.
Don't get
in my way.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Better care? I think I've got that under
control, thank you. You've no
grounds to
be telling me how to take care of myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
An empress cannot abandon those in need
for anything. A mere
scratch is no reason
to—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
B-back off! I could hear you where you
were standing before.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oh please, stop with that face. Geez,
what's gotten into you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I suppose... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fine.
I'll take the rest of the day off and
let them know we'll resume
practice at a
later date.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It won't do for an empress to allow her
audience to see her in
anything less than
an ideal state.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...And I suppose causing anxiety for one's
trainer isn't very
empress-like either.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
All right, enough talk! I'm going to nap
here for a while.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, off you go then. Do you want me to
get some rest or not?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I happily allow myself to be kicked out of
the infirmary.
